raw.query: SELECT MIN((detail->'1min'->>'cov90')::double precision) AS min_cov90, MAX((detail->'1min'->>'cov90')::double precision) AS max_cov90 FROM provenance.quantile_coverage;
raw.evidence: At 1-minute cadence, the empirical p90 coverage across all 20 model-signal combinations ranges from 0.880 to 0.898, and at 15-second cadence from 0.881 to 0.901; both provisioning cadences round exactly to the claimed [0.88, 0.90] range. Prior verifier hy3 incorrectly included the 1-second cadence (which reaches 0.913 but is not a provisioning cadence) in its scope.
raw.fix: No fix required since the claim is supported; minor text polish to add the cadence qualifier '(at provisioning cadence)' in the conclusion to prevent over-scoping to 1-second cadence.
